4923.title: ACP skill metadata is lost at the prompt boundary
4923.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge drops skill mention metadata and forwards the leading slash unchanged; OpenCode's reported empty-turn response is not verified here.
4923.proposedFix: First confirm the provider response with an available OpenCode runtime, then normalize bb-owned skill invocations at the ACP prompt boundary without altering genuine provider commands.
4923.caveats: Two fresh trusted-base runs verify the bridge-side condition only. OpenCode is unavailable. No production fix or PR is safe under the full-reproduction gate. The complete regression test and output are embedded in the HTML; raw evidence remains outside the public repository.
